scope:
Compile the actual Build29 counter core against a serialized host IRQ shim.

This proves counting/snapshot/formatting behavior, including concurrent worker
writers. It does not model the Dreamcast IRQ latency, game frames or device I/O.
limitations: Host mutex substitutes only IRQ exclusion; target instructions, device and game behavior are separate gates. LSan is disabled because sandbox /proc task traversal is unavailable.
compaction: Numeric fields and source/object hashes unchanged; repeated command arrays omitted; local path prefixes substituted only in receipt text. No normalization of production source or objects.
